mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign1, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign1 ELSE '' END AS esSign1, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign2, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign2 ELSE '' END AS esSign2, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign3, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign3 ELSE '' END AS esSign3, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign4, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign4 ELSE '' END AS esSign4, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign5, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign5 ELSE '' END AS esSign5, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign6, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign6 ELSE '' END AS esSign6, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign7, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign7 ELSE '' END AS esSign7, CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(Es_Sign8, '')) > 6 THEN Es_Sign8 ELSE '' END AS esSign8 FROM I_ElecSign WHERE Es_Code = #{ccCode} AND Es_Flag = #{ccFlag}
